summary: A Christmas memory game: the FM-1 plays the opening of a carol and you repeat it on the keys, with the phrase growing longer each level.
features: Four public-domain carols, 11 levels up to the full 32-note tune
Points per correct note, bonus for clean levels
Three misses send you to "Grump Mode" before a retry
Easy, medium and hard modes; key lights guide the first note
Piano, flute and sax samples plus synth sounds; saves best scores
